tools.name: returns-delivery_exception-classify
tools.description: Classify a supplied carrier code or order status only when it matches a documented token. Any other code stays unrecognized, and no tracking scan is added. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/returns-delivery/exception-classify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: returns-delivery_failed-pattern-detect
tools.description: Group supplied failed, undeliverable, refused, or returned orders by postcode, address, or carrier. A pattern needs at least three orders. One failure is not a carrier finding. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/returns-delivery/failed-pattern-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and do

tools.name: returns-delivery_shipping-address-validate
tools.description: Check that the supplied lines, city, postcode, and country are present, and compare a postcode with a published shape for nine country codes. The check does not confirm that a carrier can deliver. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/returns-delivery/shipping-address-validate. An unpaid call returns the x

tools.name: returns-delivery_return-shipping-cost-calculate
tools.description: Apply one matching caller-supplied rate to a return. A missing rate is not estimated, currencies are not converted, and the result is not a refund. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/returns-delivery/return-shipping-cost-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: returns-delivery_return-reason-analyze
tools.description: Count supplied return reasons exactly as written. A reason is a pattern only at three or more returns. The reason text is not rewritten and no refund is granted. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/returns-delivery/return-reason-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: returns-delivery_promise-variance
tools.description: Subtract the supplied promise timestamp from the supplied delivery timestamp. A missing timestamp is not filled in, and the comparison is not a carrier guarantee. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/returns-delivery/promise-variance. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: returns-delivery_return-window-calculate
tools.description: Add the supplied day count to the supplied delivered or ordered date and compare a return request with that end date. No day count is assumed, and an inside date is not a refund entitlement. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/returns-delivery/return-window-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 paym

tools.description: Combine supplied exceptions, failed-order groups, address structure, return rates, promise variance, and the return window. The report does not contact a carrier or grant a refund. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "returns-delivery" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: returns-delivery_shipping-address-validate · Private data: returns-delivery_exception-classify, returns-delivery_logistics-report · Public sink: returns-delivery_exception-classify, returns-delivery_failed-pattern-detect, returns-delivery_shipping-address-validate, returns-delivery_return-shipping-cost-calculate, returns-delivery_return-reason-analyze, returns-delivery_promise-variance, returns-delivery_return-window-calculate, returns-delivery_logistics-report · Destructive: returns-delivery_exception-classify, returns-delivery_failed-pattern-detect, returns-delivery_shipping-address-validate, returns-delivery_return-shipping-cost-calculate, returns-delivery_return-reason-analyze, returns-delivery_promise-variance, returns-delivery_return-window-calculate, returns-delivery_logistics-report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: returns-delivery_shipping-address-validate · Private data: returns-delivery_exception-classify, returns-delivery_logistics-report · Public sink: returns-delivery_exception-classify, returns-delivery_failed-pattern-detect, returns-delivery_shipping-address-validate, returns-delivery_return-shipping-cost-calculate, returns-delivery_return-reason-analyze, returns-delivery_promise-variance, returns-delivery_return-window-calculate, returns-delivery_logistics-report · Destructive: returns-delivery_exception-classify, returns-delivery_failed-pattern-detect, returns-delivery_shipping-address-validate, returns-delivery_return-shipping-cost-calculate, returns-delivery_return-reason-analyze, returns-delivery_promise-variance, returns-delivery_return-window-calculate, returns-delivery_logistics-report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
